do_if.value: not $ClaimingStation and player.age le $PhaseMaxEndTime and (@$KCS_TotalLosses ge 6 or (@$KCS_PausedSince and player.age - $KCS_PausedSince gt 45min))

debug_text.text: '[Careful Supply] ' + $Faction.id + ' giving up on ' + $Target.knownname + ' after losing ' + @$KCS_TotalLosses + ' supply ships' + (if @$KCS_PausedSince then ', supplies on hold since ' + $KCS_PausedSince else '')
